# braintrust_project_group_membership (Resource)

Manages one project membership in a Braintrust project group. Reference both the group and project so Terraform removes membership before destroying either object. Do not also set `member_projects` on the group resource. The API requires `create_acls` on the project to add it and `delete_acls` to remove it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "org_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "braintrust_project" "app" {
  name = "app"
}

resource "braintrust_project_group" "team" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = "Application team"
}

resource "braintrust_project_group_membership" "app" {
  project_group_id = braintrust_project_group.team.id
  project_id       = braintrust_project.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_group_id` (String) Project group ID.
- `project_id` (String) Member project ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in project_group_id/project_id form.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with project_group_id/project_id.
terraform import braintrust_project_group_membership.example <project_group_id>/<project_id>
```
